# International Delhi Public School (IDPS) Borivali

> Premier CBSE-affiliated school in Borivali West (Gorai-2), Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, operated by Shri Hari Education Trust in collaboration with St. Rock's High School. Offering 360-degree holistic education from Nursery to 7th Standard.

## Key Facts
- **Official Name:** International Delhi Public School Borivali (IDPS Borivali)
- **Trust & Collaboration:** Shri Hari Education Trust, in collaboration with St. Rock's High School
- **Board & Curriculum:** CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education), aligned with NEP 2020 & NCF-SE 2023
- **Grades Offered:** Playgroup, Nursery, Junior KG, Senior KG, and Grades 1 to 7
- **Admissions Status:** Open for Academic Year 2027-28
- **Campus Address:** IDPS Borivali Campus, RSC 15, Gorai-2, Borivali (West), Mumbai, Maharashtra 400092, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 77381 96931
- **Admissions Email:** admissions@idpsborivali.com
- **Office Email:** info@idpsborivali.com
- **Office Hours:** Monday to Saturday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM IST

## Core Programs & Facilities
- **360° Holistic Development Model:** 6 dimensions — LEARN (Intellectual), EXPLORE (Creative), CREATE (Emotional Well-being), GROW (Social Leadership), LEAD (Physical Fitness), BELONG (Ethical Values).
- **CAIR Lab:** Artificial Intelligence, Coding, and Robotics hands-on STEM lab.
- **Facilities:** Air-conditioned smart classrooms, sports turf & cricket practice cage, dance & performing arts studio, music studio, etiquette & financial literacy lab, 24/7 CCTV, and GPS-tracked school buses.
